== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Redmoon Hall]] is a powerful organization characterized by its association with the [[Bleeding Phoenix]] symbol and its use of massive, red-tinted cloudships as mobile headquarters. The group is known for being exceptionally dangerous, even surpassing standard combat specialists in lethality. Members of the [[Hall]] utilize specialized techniques involving [[Blood Shadows]], which can be integrated into weapons like axes, spears, or swords to enhance their power. The organization features a hierarchy that includes Overlords and leaders such as [[Kahn Mala]], who has been known to interact with various clans and sages. Despite its reputation, the [[Hall]] has faced internal divisions regarding whether the [[Bleeding Phoenix]] should be viewed as a divine entity or a source of power, and it has also experienced periods of instability, including being placed under the protection of a [[Void Sage]]. Notable individuals associated with the group include [[Yan Shoumei]] and various Overlords who have demonstrated combat prowess nearing the level of the [[Uncrowned]].}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Redmoon is a [[Herald]] and the leader of [[Redmoon Hall]] who monitors various situations. Originally a spirit that grew his own human body, he possesses pink skin and a milk-white line traveling through his cheek. Following a hundred years at the bottom of a desert, he appeared as a dried-up husk resembling a corpse. As a practitioner of a [[blood Path]], he eventually becomes the [[Blood Shadow]] in the relationship with the [[Sage of Red Faith]]. During a conversation with the [[Sage]], he utilized a [[Script|script]] on a control panel to broadcast their interaction.}}
